basis: Production preflight ran before migration and reported 007-011 pending with all safety checks PASS.
Railway preDeployCommand is `npm run preflight:v22-production && npm run migrate:runtime`.
migrate-runtime.mjs enumerates every .sql file in migrations in sorted order.
For each unapplied migration it executes SQL and then inserts its filename/hash into schema_migrations.
Any migration error sets a non-zero process exit code.
The application start step and Railway SUCCESS terminal state occurred only after preDeploy completed successfully.
012_v21_rollback_compatibility.sql is present in the deployed release after 011, so it was included in the successful migration runner pass.
verification.caveat: The connector could not execute an independent SELECT against schema_migrations inside the MySQL container, so this evidence is execution-chain proof rather than an independently queried row dump.

rollbackCompatibility.purpose: Preserve V2.1 project/run/usage write compatibility after V2.2 tenant/workspace NOT NULL scoping.

knownNonBlocking.npmAuditBuildWarning: 1 high severity vulnerability reported by npm audit during image build; release was not blocked. Follow-up remediation should be tracked separately.

conclusion: V2.2 is live in production. Runtime and MySQL are online, /ready is 200, commercial billing endpoints are fail-closed at 401 without authorization, and no 5xx were observed in the acceptance traffic.
